--annotations-namespace-key.help: Runtime annotations  key for kubernetes namespace

--api-version.help: Specify the API version to use

--baseline.help: run a baseline benchmark without tetragon

--bench-open-sleep.help: bench open sleep between open syscalls (us)

--bpf-lib.help: Location of Tetragon libs (btf and bpf files) (default "/var/lib/tetragon/")

--cel-expression.help: Get events satisfying the CEL expression

--cgroup-rate.help: Base sensor events cgroup rate <events,interval> disabled by default ('1000,1s' means rate 1000 events per second)

--ci-run.help: This option enables CI ignorelist for tests

--client.help: Only print client version without attempting to connect to server

--cluster-name.help: Name of the cluster where Tetragon is installed

--color.help: Colorize compact output. auto, always, or never

--command-wait.help: duration to wait for tetragon to gather logs from commands

--config-dir.help: Configuration directory that contains a file for each option

--containers.help: Get events by container name regex

--data-cache-size.help: Size of the data events cache (default 1024)

--deleted-pod-cache-size.help: Size of the deleted pod cache (default 1024)

--disable-grpc.help: do not connect to gRPC address. Instead, write a message to log

--disable-kprobe-multi.help: Allow to disable kprobe multi interface

--dump-policy-path.help: save the policy in the provided path

--enable-ancestors.help: Comma-separated list of process event types to enable ancestors for. Supported event types are: base, kprobe, tracepoint, loader, uprobe, lsm, usdt. Unknown event types will be ignored. Type 'base' enables ancestors for process_exec and process_exit events and is required by all other supported event types for correct reference counting. An empty string disables ancestors completely

--enable-cgidmap.help: enable pod resolution via cgroup ids

--enable-cgtrackerid.help: enable cgroup tracker id (only used if 'enable-cgidmap' is set) (default true)

--enable-event-metrics.help: Enable per-event metrics. Enabled by default. Health and resource metrics are always available when --metrics-server is set. (default true)

--enable-k8s-api.help: Access Kubernetes API to associate Tetragon events with Kubernetes pods

--enable-msg-handling-latency.help: Enable metrics for message handling latency

--enable-pid-set-filter.help: Enable pidSet export filters. Not recommended for production use

--enable-pod-annotations.help: Add pod annotations field to events.

--enable-policy-filter-cgroup-map.help: Enable cgroup mappings for policy filter maps

--enable-process-environment-variables.help: Include environment variables in process_exec events. Disabled by default. Note that this option can significantly increase the size of the events and may impact performance, as well as capture sensitive information such as passwords in the events (you can use --redaction-filters to redact the data).

--enable-process-ns.help: Enable namespace information in process_exec and process_kprobe events

--enable-tracing-policy-crd.help: Enable TracingPolicy and TracingPolicyNamespaced custom resources (default true)

--event-cache-retries.help: Number of retries for event cache (default 15)

--event-cache-retry-delay.help: Delay in seconds between event cache retries (default 2)

--event-queue-size.help: Set the size of the internal event queue. (default 10000)

--event-types.help: Include only events of given types

--exclude-execve-map-processes.help: exclude processes that also exist in the execve_map

--execve-map-size.help: Set size for execve_map table (allows K/M/G suffix)

--export-file-max-backups.help: Number of rotated JSON export files to retain (default 5)

--export-file-max-size-mb.help: Size in MB for rotating JSON export files (default 10)

--export-file-perm.help: Access permissions on JSON export files (default "600")

--export-file-rotation-interval.help: Interval at which to rotate JSON export files in addition to rotating them by size

--export-filename.help: Filename for JSON export. Disabled by default

--export-rate-limit.help: Rate limit (per minute) for event export. Set to -1 to disable (default -1)

--expose-stack-addresses.help: Expose real linear addresses in events stack traces

--fail-allow-namespaces.help: Command will not fail for specified namespaces. The namespace is determined by runtime annotation labels. Flag will be ignored if fail-cel-expr is set.

--fail-cel-expr.help: CEL expression to decide whether to fail (and stop container from starting) or not.

--fail-fast.help: Exit as soon as an error is encountered.

--force-large-progs.help: Force loading large programs, even in kernels with < 5.3 versions

--force-small-progs.help: Force loading small programs, even in kernels with >= 5.3 versions

--generate-docs.help: Generate documentation in YAML format to stdout

--gops-address.help: gops server address (e.g. 'localhost:8118'). Disabled by default

--grpc-address.help: gRPC address for connecting to the tetragon agent

--grpc-timeout.help: timeout for connecting to agent via gRPC

--health-probe-bind-address.help: The address the probe endpoint binds to.

--health-server-address.help: Health server address (e.g. ':6789')(use '' to disabled it) (default ":6789")

--ima-hash.help: Include ima hashes in compact output

--json-encode.help: JSON encode the events and measure overhead

--just-boot.help: Do not actually run any tests. Just setup everything and start the VM. User will be able to login to the VM.

--just-build-image.help: Just build an image. Do not actually run any tests or boot the VM.

--k8s-controlplane-retry.help: Number of attempts for Kubernetes control plane connection (negative for infinite, zero is invalid, positive for max attempts) (default 1)

--k8s-kubeconfig-path.help: Absolute path of the kubernetes kubeconfig file

--keep-all-logs.help: Normally, logs are kept only for failed tests. This switch keeps all logs.

--keep-sensors-on-exit.help: Do not unload sensors on exit

--leader-election-lease-duration.help: Duration that non-leader operator candidates will wait before forcing to acquire leadership

--leader-election-namespace.help: Kubernetes namespace in which the leader election Lease resource should be created.

--leader-election-renew-deadline.help: Duration that current acting master will retry refreshing leadership in before giving up the lock

--leader-election-retry-period.help: Duration that LeaderElector clients should wait between retries of the actions

--lines.help: Number of lines for the top BPF map memory consumers.\nUse 0 to print all lines. Only valid with tab output.

--log-file.help: Set log file where tetragon agent logs will be written (in addition to stdout or stderr)

--max-recv-size.help: The maximum message size in bytes the client can receive. Default is gRPC 4MB default.

--metrics-bind-address.help: The address the metric endpoint binds to.

--metrics-label-filter.help: Comma-separated list of enabled metrics labels. Unknown labels will be ignored. (default "namespace,workload,pod,binary")

--metrics-server.help: Metrics server address (e.g. ':2112'). Disabled by default

--monitor-mode.help: set the policy(-ies) in monitor mode before running the test(s)

--namespace-regex.help: Get events by namespace name regex

--no-clear.help: Do not clear screen between rounds

--no-poweroff.help: Do not poweroff the VM at the end of the run

--parents-map-size.help: Set size for parents_map table (allows K/M/G suffix)

--persist-grpc-policies.help: Persist tracing policies installed over gRPC across agent restarts

--persist-grpc-policies-dir.help: Directory in which to persist tracing policies installed over gRPC (default "/var/run/tetragon/grpc-policies")

--pod.help: Get events by pod name regex

--pods.help: Get events by pods name regex

--policy-names.help: Get events by tracing policy names

--pprof-address.help: Serves runtime profile data via HTTP (e.g. 'localhost:6060'). Disabled by default

--print.help: print events in JSON to stdout

--process.help: Get events by process name regex

--process-cache-gc-interval.help: Time between checking the process cache for old entries (default 30s)

--processes.help: Get events by processes name regex

--procfs.help: Location of procfs to consume existing PIDs (default "/proc/")

--qemu-cmd-print.help: Do not run the qemu command, just print it

--qemu-disable-kvm.help: Do not use KVM acceleration, even if /dev/kvm exists

--rb-queue-size.help: Set size of channel between ring buffer and sensor go routines (default 65k, allows K/M/G suffix) (default "65535")

--rb-size.help: Set ring buffer size for single cpu (default 65k, allows K/M/G suffix) (default "0")

--rb-size-total.help: Set ring buffer size in total for all cpus (default 65k per cpu, allows K/M/G suffix) (default "0")

--reconnect.help: Keep trying to connect even if an error occurred

--reconnect-wait.help: wait time before attempting to reconnect

--recursive.help: Print the fields of fields recursively

--release-pinned-bpf.help: Release all pinned BPF programs and maps in Tetragon BPF directory. Enabled by default. Set to false to disable (default true)

--root-dev.help: type of root device (hda or vda)

--server.help: Connect and retrieve version from the server

--server-address.help: gRPC server address (e.g. 'localhost:54321' or 'unix:///var/run/tetragon/tetragon.sock'). An empty address disables the gRPC server (default "localhost:54321")

--server-tls-cert-file.help: Path to a PEM-encoded server certificate. When set, TLS is enabled on the TCP gRPC listener.

--server-tls-client-ca-files.help: Paths to PEM-encoded CA bundles used to verify client certificates. Required when --server-tls-require-client-cert is true.

--server-tls-key-file.help: Path to the PEM-encoded private key matching --server-tls-cert-file. Required when --server-tls-cert-file is set.

--server-tls-require-client-cert.help: Require and verify client certificates (mTLS). Requires --server-tls-client-ca-files.

--sleepable-preload-size.help: Set the maximum number of entries in the sleepable preload map (default 32768)

--stack-traces.help: Include stack traces in compact output

--store.help: store events in JSON to stdout

--timeout.help: Interval in seconds (delay in one shot mode)

--tracing-policy.help: Tracing policy file to load at startup

--tracing-policy-dir.help: Directory from where to load Tracing Policies (default "/etc/tetragon/tetragon.tp.d")

--tty-encode.help: Encode terminal data by file path (all other events will be ignored)

--use-perf-ring-buffer.help: Use the perf ring buffer instead of the bpf ring buffer

--use-tetragon-init.help: use tetragon-vmtests-init as init process in the VM

--username-metadata.help: Resolve UIDs to user names for processes running in host namespace (default "disabled")

--verbose.help: set verbosity level for eBPF verifier dumps. Pass 0 for silent, 1 for truncated logs, 2 for a full dump

all-syscalls-list.help: all system calls using a list

dumpcgrp.help: dump cgroup ID to namespace state

explain.help: List the fields for supported resources

loglevel.help: Get and dynamically change the log level

maps.help: Retrieve information about BPF maps on the host related to tetragon

modify.help: modify a tracing policy YAML file

patch-containerd-conf.help: Patch containerd.conf to install an OCI hook

probe.help: Probe for eBPF system features availability

progs.help: Retrieve information about BPF programs on the host

set-mode.help: set the mode of a tracing policy
